purpose: Later disposition of repeated send-routing-step feedback; historical matrices remain dated records.
change: After round9, an empty mixer strip Add send opens the destination chooser directly. Existing Send summaries continue opening Routing for detailed edits.
earlier_disposition: Rounds7/8 retained the explicit routing workflow with reasoned responses. Repeated round9 friction motivated a bounded simplification that preserves explicit source/destination selection.

observations.reason: Low overall confusion because tools describe their actions. Initial playback failure and the very small trim adjustment were the main interruptions; a send required a routing panel and another menu.
observations.response: The post-round9 direct chooser removes the intermediate Routing and + Send step for an empty strip while retaining explicit source/destination and cancellation safety. This later change addresses the routing-step portion of the observation, not unrelated reservations in the same reason.
